en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al Waleed Bin Ala’a, from Hammad, from his father, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High, when He<sup>azwj</sup> Loves a servant, Immerses him in afflictions with an immersion, and Bleeds him by the afflictions with a bleeding. So when he supplicates to Him<sup>azwj</sup>, He<sup>azwj</sup> Says: “Here I<sup>azwj</sup> am, My<sup>azwj</sup> servant! I<sup>azwj</sup> can Hasten to you what you are asking for, I<sup>azwj</sup> am Able upon that, and I<sup>azwj</sup> can Set it aside for you, but whatever I<sup>azwj</sup> Set aside for you, so it is better for you’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Walid ibn al-‘Ala’ from Hammad from his father from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“When Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, loves any of His servants He immerses him in misfortunes deeply and allows him bleed a bleeding (like sacrificial animals). When he prays to Him, He answers, ‘Yes, my servant, if I like to answer your prayer quickly I have the power to do so, but if I save for you what I may save is better (for you).”’
